title: Alpha Break
tagline: Ultra-personalized, privacy-first dApp that rewards pragmatic, AI-sensed breaks with NFTs
description:
Alpha Break is a privacy-first, ultra-personalized productivity dApp that helps you rest smart — not out of exhaustion, but out of strategy.

Built as a cross-platform desktop app with Electron and confidential smart contracts on Oasis Sapphire, it uses local behavioral tracking to detect early signs of fatigue — like idle time, reduced typing speed, and lack of mouse movement.

🧠 What makes it different — and necessary:
There is nothing else like Alpha Break.

Unlike generic Pomodoro timers or corporate wellness apps, Alpha Break is intelligently adaptive. It analyzes your own best performance — how you behave when you’re energized and in flow — and uses that as your unique baseline. It nudges you to rest only when you start deviating from your own high-energy state. No arbitrary timers. No standard “rules of productivity.” No guilt.

This is wellness logic made personal, and strategic.

🦁 The Lion Philosophy:
When you confirm your break, Alpha Break rewards you with a symbolic Alpha Lion NFT — a playful, on-chain reminder that real power comes from smart choices.

The lion isn’t king of the jungle because it’s always running. It’s king because it rests, watches, and strikes with precision. Alpha Break gives users that same clarity:
You don’t win by forcing yourself to work when you’re tired — you win by being strategic about your energy.

🔥 Why it matters now:
We’re in the middle of a global burnout epidemic. Anxiety, overwork, and screen fatigue are silently crushing creativity and wellness — especially for ambitious, digital-first people.

Alpha Break is built to fix that.

It teaches you to listen to your body and patterns, not hustle metrics.

It normalizes mindful rest.

It rewards wellness with recognition.

It turns strategic pausing into a superpower.

This is more than a hackathon toy — it’s a dApp designed for real-world impact.

✅ Features:
Learns your personal typing & activity rhythm locally

Detects fatigue based on deviation from your high-performance state

Verifies via privacy-preserving smart contract

Gently prompts breaks when they’re truly needed

Mints a unique Alpha Lion NFT as a reward

🔐 Privacy-First, Always:
No account required. No data sent to the cloud.
Fatigue checks are done either locally or via Oasis confidential contract —
because your energy patterns are your business, not anyone else’s.

🚀 Built for:
People who want to do their best work —
without burning out.

People who believe that pragmatic productivity beats blind hustle.
People ready to work smarter, not harder.

👑 Alpha Break is unique:
No other tool combines local AI, confidential smart contracts, and NFT rewards
to detect personalized fatigue patterns and encourage real, restorative breaks.

It’s wellness-aware productivity, designed for a world that desperately needs it.
how_its_made:
🔧 How It’s Made
Alpha Break is a privacy-first, AI-inspired desktop dApp designed to intelligently detect when you're running low on energy — and reward you with an NFT when you take a strategic break. It merges local behavior analytics, confidential smart contracts on Oasis Sapphire, and fun, visual rewards to encourage smarter wellness habits.
🖥 Electron Desktop App
We chose Electron to wrap our app in a native shell. This gives us:

Access to typing, scrolling, mouse activity (without browser limitations)

Ability to trigger break popups that take over focus

Persistent storage for behavior baselining using localStorage

Frontend lives in index.html, while logic is handled in renderer.js and Electron’s main.js.

🧠 Local AI-Like Behavior Engine
Rather than one-size-fits-all timers, Alpha Break watches you:

Tracks real-time keyboard/mouse/scroll events

Builds a personal energy baseline based on your actual performance

Triggers prompts when your activity drops below your normal, not some made-up productivity ideal

This behavior is analyzed entirely on-device, never uploaded or tracked. Think of it as your own wellness co-pilot.

🔐 Oasis Sapphire Confidential Contract
To enhance trust and privacy, we offload some decisions to a confidential smart contract on Oasis Sapphire:

shouldPromptBreak(idleSeconds, typingSpeed) securely decides if a break is needed

The contract runs inside an encrypted Oasis runtime

Inputs are never visible to validators or on-chain observers

This is a major privacy upgrade compared to any cloud-based solution

📎 View Contract on Sourcify (Verified)

🦁 NFT Rewards via MetaMask + Thirdweb
When you confirm the break, a mint screen opens:

Wallet connects via MetaMask

Minting is handled via Thirdweb SDK on Base Sepolia

A random Alpha Lion NFT is minted and sent to the user

Each NFT is a visual pat on the back — a collectible reward for choosing to rest smart.

🎨 Lion Art: Generated with Canva AI
The lion NFTs were pre-generated using Canva’s AI image generation tools:

We created 20 unique Alpha Lion images that represent the idea of pragmatic rest and strategic energy

Stored locally in assets/lions/ and randomly picked at break time

Minted only if the user truly rests and confirms it

Canva AI gave us fast, high-quality visuals without the need for custom illustration work.

🛠 Stack Overview
Purpose	Tech Used
App Framework	Electron (cross-platform native app)
Behavior Engine	Vanilla JavaScript + localStorage
Confidential Logic	Oasis Sapphire smart contract (shouldPromptBreak)
NFT Minting	Thirdweb SDK + MetaMask on Base Sepolia
Visuals / Assets	Canva AI (lion NFTs)
Smart Contract	Solidity + Sourcify-verified
Chain IDs	Oasis Sapphire: 23295 · Base Sepolia: 84532

🌟 Oasis Impact
Without Oasis, this project wouldn’t be possible — not in a way that respects user dignity. Here’s why it was critical:

Privacy-preserving logic: You can offload logic to the chain without exposing personal data.

No need for a backend: Oasis contracts act like a trustless API.

User trust: When users know nothing is sent to a server or shared on-chain, they feel safer using the app.

Verified transparency: Despite confidentiality, our contract is open and verified on Sourcify.

Alpha Break reimagines productivity — from hustle to harmony, from exhaustion to intelligence — and Oasis makes that vision technically and ethically viable.
